scope: Single clean synthetic example per type; strict canonical contract, not OCR accuracy, tax-preparation accuracy, or real-world accuracy.

reference_comparator.role: bounded comparison only; subscription CLI is not the application SDK/API transport

local_followup_candidate.basis: highest observed strict full-corpus canonical field match among five requested local tags; exploratory pre-freeze inference only, not an immutable-checkpoint ranking

required_contract_work: Add dedicated 1099-R and 1040 extraction schemas; generic-label output is not canonical support.
Resolve tax_year type and coded-object key conventions before interpreting serialization misses as reading failures.
limitations: No evaluated model passes the strict 12-form gate.
Local and initial Haiku inference lack launch-time runner/grader hashes; final scoring is receipt-bound without changing raw outputs.
Retain both Haiku trials; do not select only the higher score.

Local resident snapshots change digests within the Qwen and Gemma 4 tag runs, and inventory has duplicate/mismatching tags. Response tag identity is verified, but local aggregates do not establish one immutable checkpoint per tag.
Timings include rendering, network, model load, and CLI startup where applicable; one pass is not a statistical ranking.
